jobs.notes: Preventive, downy mildew (Peronospora effusa); 50 L water/στρ. Applied 11:30, leaves dry.

synthetic_inputs.why: Prototype lacks hourly weather, sun times, job duration, and label target / max applications / min interval. Hourly P3 series: daily tmin/tmax, max gust, rain total and leaf-wet counts kept; Mon has a breezy dry afternoon, Tue dries only at 14:00 then goes calm, Wed dries at 10:00 with a 15:00 sea breeze; rain starts Fri 18:00 ('Fri 20 evening'). Label extras are TEST-ONLY values, never to be imported as label data.

vetoes.reason: same_group_consecutive (FRAC 28 after FRAC 28 on this lot)

must_not.why: app never chooses product or dose

source_text.action: Spray mandipropamid 25% SC (FRAC 40), 0.06 L/στρ in 50 L water/στρ, on the 1.5 στρ spinach only. Cut chard, coriander and spring onion on the same parcel BEFORE spraying; leave one unsprayed bed as buffer next to them (product not registered on those crops). New safe-to-harvest date: Wed 2 Dec; REI 24 h.
source_text.why_rule: Spray only if: leaves dry (after dew ~10:00), gust < 20 km/h, no rain for >= 24 h after (product needs ~1 h to dry), planting not harvesting, new PHI ends before harvest starts, FRAC group different from the last spray on this lot, product registered for crop and in stock and not expired.

notes: The engine lists every option that passes the arbiter (PR01 copper M01 and PR03 mandipropamid); the prototype named only mandipropamid – Bora/agronomist choose. PR04 is vetoed by ROT (test param max 1 consecutive). PHI-GUARD passes only because buffer = 0: PR03 safe 2 Dec vs harvest 3 Dec. Hour-level reasons for Tue also include leaves_dry_too_short; 'include' semantics for rejected_days.
